Step 2: Create d:\tradebridge\src\components\bots\BotDashboard.tsx. 'use client'. Import BotConfig, BotRun, BotRunState from './bot-types'. Import upsertBotConfig, deleteBotConfig from './bot-storage'. Import styles from './BotDashboard.module.css'. Props: {configs:BotConfig[]; runs:BotRun[]; runState:BotRunState; activeConfigId:string|null; onSelectConfig:(id:string)=>void; onNewConfig:(config:BotConfig)=>void; onDeleteConfig:(id:string)=>void; onImportConfig:(config:BotConfig)=>void}. State: showModal:boolean, importError:string, modalFields for the quick-strategy form (symbol:string='R_100', contractType:string='DIGITOVER', stake:number=1, profitTarget:number|null, lossLimit:number|null, maxTrades:number|null). Four action cards: 'New Bot' (⚡, onClick sets showModal true), 'Import Bot' (📂, triggers hidden file input), 'Quick Strategy' (🎯, sets showModal true), 'View Bots' (📋, noop scroll). Bot list table: for each config, show Name, Symbol, Contract Type, Last run status (look up last run from runs by botId), Select button (calls onSelectConfig(config.id)), Delete button (calls onDeleteConfig + deleteBotConfig). Active row highlighted when config.id===activeConfigId. Empty state when configs.length===0: 'No bots yet. Create your first bot using the Bot Builder or Quick Strategy.' Quick-strategy modal: form-like controlled inputs for symbol (text input), contract type (select: DIGITOVER/DIGITUNDER/DIGITEVEN/DIGITODD/DIGITMATCH/DIGITDIFF), stake (number), profit target (number, optional), loss limit (number, optional), max trades (number, optional). Confirm creates a BotConfig with crypto.randomUUID() id, duration:5, durationUnit:'t', stakeStrategy:{type:'fixed',amount:stake}, stopConditions built from non-null modal values, cooldownSeconds:2, maxTradesPerDay:50, maxConsecutiveLosses:5, createdAt/updatedAt:Date.now(). Calls onNewConfig(config). File import: hidden <input type='file' accept='.json' ref={fileRef}>. On change: read file, JSON.parse, validate shape (must have id, name, symbol as strings), call onImportConfig. On invalid: set importError message. Recent runs table below bot list: columns Bot Name / Started / Ended / Trades / Win% / Net P&L / Status.

Step 4: Create d:\tradebridge\src\components\bots\BotBuilderInner.tsx. 'use client'. Import from 'blockly' and 'blockly/javascript'. Import BotConfig from './bot-types'. Import styles from './BotBuilder.module.css'. This is the actual Blockly component — loaded only client-side. (a) Define six custom blocks using Blockly.Blocks[...].init: trade_parameters (fields: symbol TEXT default 'R_100', contractType DROPDOWN options [['Digit Over','DIGITOVER'],['Digit Under','DIGITUNDER'],['Even','DIGITEVEN'],['Odd','DIGITODD'],['Matches','DIGITMATCH'],['Differs','DIGITDIFF']], duration NUMBER default 5); trade_options (fields: stake NUMBER default 1, currency TEXT default 'USD'); purchase_conditions (fields: condition DROPDOWN [['Always','always'],['On signal only','signal']]); restart_trading (fields: on DROPDOWN [['On win','win'],['On loss','loss'],['Always','always']]); stake_management (fields: strategy DROPDOWN [['Fixed','fixed'],['Martingale','martingale'],['D''Alembert','dalembert']], base NUMBER default 1, multiplier NUMBER default 2, maxStake NUMBER default 100); stop_conditions (fields: profitTarget NUMBER default 0, lossLimit NUMBER default 0, maxTrades NUMBER default 0 — zero means disabled). All blocks: colour 230, output null (statement blocks), tooltip strings. (b) Register javascript generators for each block (return field values as a JSON comment — the converter reads the workspace object directly, not generated code). (c) Define dark Blockly theme using Blockly.Theme.defineTheme('tradebridgeDark', {base:Blockly.Themes.Classic, componentStyles:{workspaceBackgroundColour:'#0b1320',toolboxBackgroundColour:'#131c2e',toolboxForegroundColour:'#f1f5f9',flyoutBackgroundColour:'#1a2438',flyoutForegroundColour:'#f1f5f9',insertionMarkerColour:'#10b981',scrollbarColour:'#334155',scrollbarOpacity:.8}}). (d) Toolbox JSON: {kind:'categoryToolbox',contents:[{kind:'category',name:'Trade Setup',colour:'230',contents:[{kind:'block',type:'trade_parameters'},{kind:'block',type:'trade_options'}]},{kind:'category',name:'Money Management',colour:'120',contents:[{kind:'block',type:'stake_management'},{kind:'block',type:'restart_trading'}]},{kind:'category',name:'Conditions',colour:'65',contents:[{kind:'block',type:'purchase_conditions'},{kind:'block',type:'stop_conditions'}]},{kind:'category',name:'Logic',colour:'210',contents:[{kind:'block',type:'controls_if'},{kind:'block',type:'logic_compare'},{kind:'block',type:'math_number'},{kind:'block',type:'text'},{kind:'block',type:'math_arithmetic'}]}]}. (e) useEffect: inject Blockly into containerRef.current with toolbox, theme:'tradebridgeDark', trashcan:true, scrollbars:true, zoom:{controls:true,wheel:true,startScale:1.0}. Cleanup: workspace.dispose(). (f) workspaceToBotConfig(ws, name): iterate ws.getAllBlocks(), find 'trade_parameters', 'trade_options', 'stake_management', 'stop_conditions' blocks, read field values via block.getFieldValue(). Return BotConfig or null if trade_parameters not found. (g) Props: {onSaveConfig:(config:BotConfig)=>void}. State: botName:string, statusMsg:string, errorMsg:string. Save button calls workspaceToBotConfig; on null shows errorMsg 'Add a Trade Setup block first'; on success calls onSaveConfig and shows statusMsg 'Bot saved'.

Import loadBotConfigs, saveBotConfigs, loadBotRuns, upsertBotConfig, deleteBotConfig from './bot-storage'. Import useBotRunner from './useBotRunner'. Import RunPanel from './RunPanel'. Derived: activeConfig = configs.find(c=>c.id===activeConfigId)??null. useBotRunner(connected, account, activeConfig) → {runState, start, stop}. Handlers: handleSaveConfig (upsertBotConfig + update configs state + set activeConfigId), handleDeleteConfig (deleteBotConfig + update configs state + clear activeConfigId if deleted), handleImportConfig (upsertBotConfig + update configs state). Layout: <div> with two children: (1) inner tab bar — two <button> elements with .workspaceTab / .workspaceTabActive classes; (2) <div className={styles.botsLayout}> with main content div (BotDashboard or BotBuilder) and <RunPanel ...> aside. Wrap in a <section> with className={styles.botsPage}.
acceptance_criteria: BotDashboard renders four action cards, a bot list table, and a quick-strategy modal
Quick-strategy modal creates a BotConfig with correct shape and calls onNewConfig
File import validates JSON shape and shows error on invalid input
BotBuilderInner mounts Blockly workspace with all six custom blocks in the toolbox
Save button in BotBuilder extracts field values and produces a valid BotConfig
BotsWorkspace renders inner tab bar and shows correct child per tab
RunPanel always visible alongside both inner tabs
verification: npm run build (from d:\tradebridge) exits 0 — confirms no SSR Blockly crash
findings: Blockly 10.x typings have a variance quirk: FieldDropdown extends Field<string> but Input.appendField expects Field<string|undefined>. Fixed by casting via a local AnyField type alias. Also, setOutput(null) is not a valid call — the signature is setOutput(boolean) — so all six blocks use setOutput(true) with no check argument, which permits any output connection. Both tsc --noEmit and npm run build exit 0.
